transfers.reason: Dasilva xpts 6.35 -> Vuskovic xpts 9.78 (+3.43 in XI). Vuskovic 797/810 mins (nailed), 58 pts, 6 CS, 7.4% EO; first BHA asset, so no 3-per-club issue. Hill (9.67) rejected: would be a 4th BOU player (Silva/Tavernier/Evanilson). Konsa (Gemini's pick) rejected: club tag ARS vs real-world AVL is suspect and his GW5 mins_share was 0.53. chip.reason: All four first-half chips are already used (BB GW2, WC GW3, TC GW4, FH GW9), so the GW19 forcing rule does not apply. The only chip left is WC x1. WC trigger is not met: 1 starter is rotation-flagged (Manzambi), not 3+, and the season average is about 67 pts/GW (607 over 9), well above 55. No DGW or BGW data, so nothing triggers TC, BB or FH, and those chips are used anyway.

consistency_checks.rotation_gate: Manzambi BENCHED: 384 mins over 9 GWs is about 43 per GW, under 60. All other starters average 64 or more per GW (Rudoni 645 = 72/GW, Isak 657 = 73/GW). Last-5 and sub-off data were not available, so the gate used season mins from player_pool.json.
consistency_checks.blank_check: No cache/fixtures.json. xpts.json gives an FDR for all 15, so there is no BGW. Only FDR-5 player is Belloumi (HUL, xpts 2.54), who is benched. The high-blank-risk flag does not apply.
consistency_checks.bench_depth: Leno is the reliable GK (810 mins). Robertson (574 = 64/GW) and Belloumi (685 = 76/GW) both average over 45 mins.

captain_rationale: Locked rule: Haaland is the season cum_pts leader among owned nailed premiums (68 pts, 799/810 mins). Next are Isak 53 and Rogers 50. He is also intel.captain_shield (about 140% EO): do not fade. Vice = Isak, the next highest cum_pts premium in the XI.
projected_xpts_note: Recomputed: 11 starters sum to 85.15, plus Haaland 9.91 again for the armband, gives 95.06. The arithmetic is correct. The total is above the 45-75 band because this week's xpts.json scale looks inflated (for example a DEF on 12.87). The same squad under Gemini's method sums to about 94 but Gemini reports 67.49. Compare engines on ranking, not on absolute xPts.
